meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-stats 后,会显示当前会话的真实 token 使用量和估算节省(直接从会话日志读取,非 AI 估算),以及规则开销和净节省;当净节省为负时,会明确说明并建议关闭该功能。
howto.when: 当你在对话中输入 /caveman-stats 时触发统计显示。没有其他触发条件。

say.note: 显示当前会话的真实 token 用量和节省估算。
触发同一命令,返回开销与净节省明细。

say.text: 查一下 /caveman-stats 的节省情况
say.note: 会返回净节省;若为负会建议关闭 caveman。

howto.what_en: On /caveman-stats, it shows real token usage and estimated savings for the session (from the session log, not AI-estimated), plus rule overhead and net. If net is negative, it says so and suggests disabling caveman.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user types /caveman-stats. The hook injects the output; the model does not compute numbers.

say_en.note: Shows real token usage and savings for this session.
Same command; returns overhead and net details.
Returns net savings; suggests disabling caveman if negative.
